exercises.q: ______ the evidence carefully before drawing any conclusions, and you will avoid making hasty judgments.
exercises.explain: 祈使句+and+结果结构中，祈使部分用动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ (not underestimate) the complexity of the issue, or you will oversimplify the solution.
exercises.explain: 否定祈使句+or+否定结果的结构中，祈使部分用Don't加动词原形。

exercises.q: The sentence "Having considered all the options, choose the one that best aligns with your values." contains an imperative clause.
exercises.explain: 主句choose the one是祈使句，前面的分词短语作状语。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using an imperative structure: "If you embrace uncertainty, you will discover new opportunities."
exercises.answer: Embrace uncertainty, and you will discover new opportunities.
exercises.explain: if条件句可转换为祈使句+and+结果的结构。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "Having reviewed the report, to submit it to the committee by Friday."
exercises.answer: Having reviewed the report, submit it to the committee by Friday.
exercises.explain: 分词状语后的主句必须是祈使句，动词用原形，不能带to。

exercises.q: ______ yourself to be challenged by new ideas, for that is how intellectual growth occurs.
exercises.explain: 祈使句表示建议，以动词原形开头，for引导原因补充说明。

exercises.q: ______ that every decision has consequences, and you will approach choices with greater wisdom.
exercises.explain: 祈使句+and+结果结构中，祈使部分用动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ not to confuse confidence with arrogance, as the distinction is crucial in professional settings.
exercises.explain: 祈使句以be动词原形开头，后接形容词短语作表语。

exercises.q: ______ the data from multiple sources before presenting your findings, or your conclusions may be questioned.
exercises.explain: 祈使句+or+否定结果的结构中，祈使部分用动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ (consider) the long-term implications of your decision before committing to it.
exercises.explain: 祈使句表示建议，以动词原形开头。

exercises.q: ______ (be) mindful of the cultural differences when communicating with international colleagues.
exercises.explain: be动词在祈使句中用原形Be，后接形容词短语。

exercises.q: In the sentence "Don't let fear of failure prevent you from pursuing your goals.", the subject of the imperative is explicitly stated.
exercises.explain: 祈使句的主语you始终被省略，即使句子较长也不显性出现。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as an imperative with "or": "If you don't plan ahead, you will face unnecessary difficulties."
exercises.answer: Plan ahead, or you will face unnecessary difficulties.
exercises.explain: 否定if条件句可转换为祈使句+or+否定结果的结构。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "never" as a negative imperative: "Don't compromise your integrity for short-term gains."
exercises.answer: Never compromise your integrity for short-term gains.
exercises.explain: Never可替代Don't ever用于强调否定祈使句。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: "Don't letting temporary setbacks discourage you from pursuing your long-term vision."
exercises.answer: Don't let temporary setbacks discourage you from pursuing your long-term vision.
exercises.explain: 否定祈使句Don't后必须跟动词原形，不能用动名词。

grammar.key: Future Simple Tense with 'will' / 一般将来时 (will)
grammar.title: 一般将来时 will 全解：预测、承诺、结果与条件句联动
grammar.titleEn: Future Simple with 'will': Predictions, Promises, Results & Conditional Links
grammar.usage:
一般将来时 will 的核心结构为“will + 动词原形”，无人称和数的变化。will 常缩写为 'll，否定形式为 will not / won't，疑问句将 will 提前至主语前。该时态主要用于：说话当下做出的决定、对未来的预测、承诺、威胁、以及“前因后果”式的将来结果。

在初中阶段，will 主要表示“将要发生的事”，常与 tomorrow、next week、in the future 等时间状语连用。高中阶段则更强调 will 的语用功能：即时决定（spontaneous decision）、基于常识或经验的预测、正式语体中的承诺与声明，以及“祈使句 + and + 主语 + will”这一高频结果句型。

will 与 be going to 是高中必须区分的重点。will 偏向“说话时才做出的决定”或“没有明显证据的预测”；be going to 偏向“事先计划好的打算”或“有现有迹象的预测”。此外，在条件状语从句和时间状语从句中，从句用一般现在时表将来，主句才用 will，这是高考书面表达和语法填空的高频考点。

易错点一：will 后面必须接动词原形，不能接动词的第三人称单数、过去式或不定式。易错点二：在 if / when / as soon as 等引导的从句中，不用 will 表将来，而用一般现在时。易错点三：will 与 be going to 在“预测”义上有时可互换，但表示“已有计划”时不能随意用 will 替换。易错点四：will 的否定缩写是 won't，不是 willn't；'ll 只用于主语之后，不能用于句首或疑问句中。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + will + 动词原形（will 可缩写为 'll）
否定句：主语 + will not / won't + 动词原形
一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形...?
祈使句 + and + 主语 + will + 动词原形（表示“做……就会……”）
条件句主句：If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will + 动词原形
There will be + 名词（表示“将会有……”）
notes: will 后必须接动词原形，高考语法填空常考 will 后误填 doing、to do 或过去式的错误。
在 if、when、unless、as soon as 等引导的从句中，用一般现在时表将来，主句才用 will，这是高考书面表达中高频失分点。
won't 是 will not 的缩写，书写时注意撇号位置；'ll 不能用于疑问句句首，如不能说 'll you come?
书面语中，表示正式承诺、公告或威胁时，will 比 be going to 更正式、更果断，适合用于议论文和正式信函。
“祈使句 + and + 主语 + will”句型中，and 前后是因果关系，高考常与 or（否则）进行对比考查。

examples.en: I will help you with your homework tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚我会帮你做作业。

examples.en: She won't be late for school tomorrow.
examples.cn: 她明天上学不会迟到。

examples.en: Will there be a concert in our city next month?
examples.cn: 下个月我们城市会有一场音乐会吗？

examples.en: Stick with them, and you'll become lean and fit.
examples.cn: 坚持下去，你就会变得苗条健康。

examples.en: If you follow the doctor's advice, you will recover much sooner.
examples.cn: 如果你听从医生的建议，你会恢复得快得多。

examples.en: The government has announced that it will invest heavily in renewable energy over the next decade.
examples.cn: 政府已宣布将在未来十年大力投资可再生能源。

exercises.q: I think it ______ sunny tomorrow.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示用一般将来时 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: We ______ (have) a picnic this Sunday.
exercises.explain: this Sunday 表将来，用 will have。

exercises.q: She will comes to my party tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 后必须用动词原形 come，不是 comes。

exercises.q: I will go to school by bike. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I will not go to school by bike.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，可缩写为 won't。

exercises.q: He wills go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.answer: He will go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 是情态动词，没有第三人称单数形式 wills。

exercises.q: She ______ twelve years old next month.
exercises.explain: will 后面必须接动词原形 be。

exercises.q: They ______ a football match this afternoon.
exercises.explain: this afternoon 表示将来，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: My brother ______ to Beijing next week.
exercises.explain: next week 是将来时间，用 will go。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework.
exercises.explain: 表示承诺用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: He ______ (be) back in five minutes.
exercises.explain: in five minutes 表示将来，用 will be。

exercises.q: I hope you ______ (like) the gift.
exercises.explain: hope 后的将来动作用 will like。

exercises.q: I'll call you tonight.
exercises.explain: I'll 是 I will 的缩写，后接动词原形 call。

exercises.q: They will play basketball after class. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will they play basketball after class?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She will visit her grandma. (用 won't 改写为否定句)
exercises.explain: won't 是 will not 的缩写，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: They will playing football after school.
exercises.answer: They will play football after school.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形 play，不是 playing。

exercises.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ at home.
exercises.explain: if 条件句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表将来。

exercises.q: I think it ______ (not rain) tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 否定将来用 won't + 动词原形。

exercises.q: I will can swim after taking lessons.
exercises.explain: will 和 can 不能连用，应改为 will be able to swim。

exercises.q: He can finish the work. (用 next week 改写为一般将来时)
exercises.answer: He will be able to finish the work next week.
exercises.explain: can 的将来时形式是 will be able to。

exercises.q: If you will come tomorrow, I will be happy.
exercises.answer: If you come tomorrow, I will be happy.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中用一般现在时代替将来时。

exercises.q: —The phone is ringing. —I ______ it.
exercises.explain: 临时决定做某事用 will。

exercises.q: I'm sure you ______ the exam.
exercises.explain: 表示预测用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Maybe she ______ us at the station.
exercises.explain: maybe 表示不确定的将来预测，用 will meet。

exercises.q: Work hard, and you ______ good grades.
exercises.explain: 祈使句 + and + 主语 + will 表示结果。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ (come) to my house this evening?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) able to drive a car in two years.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Hurry up, or you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: 祈使句 + or + 主语 + will 表示否则会发生的将来结果。

exercises.q: She will go shopping this afternoon. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She won't go shopping this afternoon.
exercises.explain: won't 是 will not 的缩写，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: I will help you with your English. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will you help me with my English?
exercises.explain: 改疑问句时注意人称 I/you 的转换。

exercises.q: She will is a teacher after graduation.
exercises.answer: She will be a teacher after graduation.
exercises.explain: will 后必须用动词原形 be，不是 is。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the meeting ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用将来完成时。

exercises.q: By next year, she ______ (learn) English for five years.
exercises.explain: by next year 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: She said she will come to the party the next day.
exercises.explain: 主句过去时，宾语从句应用过去将来时 would come。

exercises.q: He said, "I will finish the work tomorrow." (改为间接引语)
exercises.answer: He said that he would finish the work the next day.
exercises.explain: 直接引语转间接引语时 will 变为 would，tomorrow 变为 the next day。

exercises.q: By the end of this month, we will finish the project.
exercises.answer: By the end of this month, we will have finished the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of 表示到将来某时为止，应用将来完成时。

exercises.q: I don't know if he ______ tomorrow. If he ______, I'll call you.
exercises.explain: 第一个 if 表示是否，用将来时；第二个 if 表示条件，用一般现在时。

exercises.q: The train ______ at 8:30 according to the timetable.
exercises.explain: 按时刻表发生的将来动作用一般现在时。

exercises.q: I ______ you as soon as I ______ in Shanghai.
exercises.explain: as soon as 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时。

exercises.q: Look at the clouds! It ______ rain soon.
exercises.explain: 有迹象表明要发生的事用 be going to，不用 will。

exercises.q: He promised that he ______ (return) the book soon.
exercises.explain: 主句过去时，宾语从句用过去将来时 would return。

exercises.q: I ______ (be) about to leave when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: was about to do 表示正要做某事时另一动作发生。

exercises.q: The concert is to begin at 7 p.m. tomorrow.
exercises.explain: be to do 可以表示按计划安排将要发生的动作。

exercises.q: She is going to buy a new car. (用 will 改写，保持意思基本不变)
exercises.answer: She will buy a new car.
exercises.explain: be going to 和 will 都可表示将来的计划。

exercises.q: I will be able to solve this problem. (用 can 的适当形式改写)
exercises.explain: will be able to 在现在时态下可简化为 can。

exercises.q: I was going to call you, but I forget your number.
exercises.answer: I was going to call you, but I forgot your number.
exercises.explain: but 后的并列句应用一般过去时 forgot，与前面时态一致。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework after dinner.
exercises.explain: 此处表示说话时的承诺，用 will + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Stick with your plan, and you ______ (see) good results.
exercises.explain: 祈使句 + and + 主语 + will 表示必然结果。

exercises.q: The sentence "She will comes to the party." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，comes 应改为 come。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I will go to the cinema tonight.
exercises.answer: I will not (won't) go to the cinema tonight.
exercises.explain: will 的否定形式是 will not，可缩写为 won't。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: He will goes to Beijing next week.
exercises.answer: He will go to Beijing next week.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，goes 应改为 go。

exercises.q: Look at the dark clouds! It ______ soon.
exercises.explain: 根据迹象预测即将发生的天气，用 will 表示预测。

exercises.q: If you eat too much junk food, you ______ weight.
exercises.explain: 条件句主句用 will 表示未来结果。

exercises.q: I promise I ______ late for class again.
exercises.explain: promise 后接 will 的否定形式 won't 表示承诺。

exercises.q: Maybe we ______ a new English teacher next term.
exercises.explain: maybe 常与 will 连用，表示对未来不确定的推测。

exercises.q: I think our team ______ (win) the match tomorrow.
exercises.explain: I think 后接 will 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: Don't call me at 9 p.m. I ______ (watch) my favourite show then.
exercises.explain: at 9 p.m. 表示将来某个具体时间点正在进行的动作，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: In the sentence "You'll feel better after a good rest.", "You'll" means "You will".
exercises.explain: 'll 是 will 的缩写形式，You'll = You will。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: They will arrive at 8 o'clock.
exercises.explain: 一般将来时变疑问句时，将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using the contracted form: You will become stronger if you exercise daily.
exercises.answer: You'll become stronger if you exercise daily.
exercises.explain: You will 可缩写为 You'll，口语中更常见。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I willn't tell anyone your secret.
exercises.answer: I won't tell anyone your secret.
exercises.explain: will not 的缩写是 won't，不是 willn't。

exercises.q: By the time you get home, I ______ dinner.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用将来完成时表示将来某时前已完成。

exercises.q: This time next year, we ______ (study) at university.
exercises.explain: this time next year 表示将来某一时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: The sentence "If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: if 条件状语从句中用一般现在时代替将来时，应改为 If it rains。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "be going to": I will buy a new laptop this weekend.
exercises.answer: I am going to buy a new laptop this weekend.
exercises.explain: 表示计划或打算时，will 可替换为 be going to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: When he will arrive, please tell me immediately.
exercises.answer: When he arrives, please tell me immediately.
exercises.explain: when 引导时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，不用 will。

exercises.q: I'm not sure if he ______ to the meeting. He hasn't replied yet.
exercises.explain: if 引导宾语从句时表示"是否"，从句用 will 表示将来。

exercises.q: Don't worry. You ______ the exam if you keep reviewing like this.
exercises.explain: if 条件句主句用 will 表示未来结果。

exercises.q: The train ______ at 7:30 according to the timetable.
exercises.explain: 按时刻表发生的将来动作用一般现在时，不用 will。

exercises.q: I ______ you as soon as I arrive at the airport.
exercises.explain: as soon as 引导时间状语从句用一般现在时，主句用 will 表示将来。

exercises.q: By next month, she ______ (work) here for ten years.
exercises.explain: by + 将来时间 + for 一段时间，用将来完成时表示持续到将来的动作。

exercises.q: I ______ (meet) my old friend at the café this afternoon. We've already arranged it.
exercises.explain: 已经安排好的将来动作用现在进行时，不用 will。

exercises.q: In the sentence "I'll be waiting for you at the station.", the speaker is describing an action in progress at a future time.
exercises.explain: will be waiting 是将来进行时，表示将来某时正在进行的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "will have done": By 2026, they will complete the project.
exercises.answer: By 2026, they will have completed the project.
exercises.explain: by + 将来时间用将来完成时，强调将来某时前已完成。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a negative question: You will attend the ceremony.
exercises.explain: 否定疑问句将 won't 提前，表示惊讶或确认。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She will has finished the report by Friday.
exercises.answer: She will have finished the report by Friday.
exercises.explain: will 后接 have done 构成将来完成时，has 应改为 have。

exercises.q: Had he not been so stubborn, he ______ the opportunity that was right in front of him.
exercises.explain: 虚拟条件句倒装，表示与过去事实相反，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: By the time the committee reaches a decision, we ______ (wait) for over two hours.
exercises.explain: by the time + 一般现在时，主句用将来完成进行时强调持续到将来的动作。

exercises.q: The sentence "By next June, she will have been teaching for thirty years." implies that she is still teaching at that future point.
exercises.explain: 将来完成进行时表示动作持续到将来某时且仍在进行。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using inversion: If you should need any help, please contact the front desk.
exercises.answer: Should you need any help, please contact the front desk.
exercises.explain: if 条件句中含有 should 时，可省略 if 并倒装。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the time he will arrive, the meeting will have already started.
exercises.answer: By the time he arrives, the meeting will have already started.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，不用 will。

exercises.q: The new policy ______ into effect next month, according to the official announcement.
exercises.explain: 官方宣布的未来事实用 will 表示，强调正式预测或承诺。

exercises.q: By the time the rescue team arrives, the survivors ______ without food for three days.
exercises.explain: by the time + 一般现在时，主句用将来完成时表示持续到将来的状态。

exercises.q: I ______ my dissertation by the end of this semester, but I'm not entirely confident.
exercises.explain: by the end of + 将来时间，用将来完成时表示将来某时前完成的动作。

exercises.q: Should you require any further assistance, our staff ______ more than happy to help.
exercises.explain: Should 引导的倒装条件句，主句用 will 表示将来结果。

exercises.q: At this rate, the company ______ (exhaust) its resources before the year ends.
exercises.explain: before + 一般现在时，主句用将来完成时表示将来某时前完成的动作。

exercises.q: If the current trend continues, sea levels ______ (rise) by at least 30 cm by 2050.
exercises.explain: by + 将来时间，用将来完成时表示将来某时前完成的动作。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He will have left by the time you get there.", the leaving happens after your arrival.
exercises.explain: will have left 表示在你到达之前已经离开，动作先于到达。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "will have been doing": By midnight, they will have worked on the project for twelve hours.
exercises.answer: By midnight, they will have been working on the project for twelve hours.
exercises.explain: 强调持续到将来某时的动作，用将来完成进行时。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be to do": The president will visit the disaster area next week.
exercises.answer: The president is to visit the disaster area next week.
exercises.explain: be to do 表示官方安排或计划好的将来动作。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She will have been finished the report by the time the manager returns.
exercises.answer: She will have finished the report by the time the manager returns.
exercises.explain: finish 是短暂性动词，不用于将来完成进行时，应改为将来完成时。

grammar.key: Comparative Adjectives / 形容词比较级
grammar.title: 形容词比较级：从 -er 到 more / less / fewer 的拓展用法
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Adjectives: From -er to more / less / fewer
grammar.usage:
形容词比较级用于比较两个对象在某一属性上的差异。核心结构是“比较级 + than”，than 引出被比较的对象。初中阶段主要学习单音节形容词加 -er（如 taller, heavier）以及多音节形容词前加 more（如 more beautiful）。高中阶段需要进一步掌握比较级的多种扩展形式，尤其是“数量名词 + more / less / fewer + than”这一结构，用来表达“多出/少出多少数量”。

肯定句结构为“A + 谓语 + 数量词 + more/less/fewer + 名词 + than + B”，例如：He sleeps two hours more than I do. 否定句在谓语部分加 not，例如：He does not sleep two hours more than I do. 疑问句将助动词提前，例如：Does he sleep two hours more than you? 需要注意的是，more 可修饰可数与不可数名词，less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰可数名词复数。

与近义结构对比：more than 表示“比……更多”，less than 表示“比……更少（不可数）”，fewer than 表示“比……更少（可数）”。此外，“as + 原级 + as”表示同级比较，“not as/so + 原级 + as”表示不如……。高中还需区分“more + 名词 + than”与“more than + 数量词”的差异：前者是比较结构，后者意为“超过、不止”。

初中用法侧重比较级的基本构成规则：单音节加 -er、以 e 结尾加 -r、辅音字母加 y 变 i 加 -er、重读闭音节双写末尾辅音字母再加 -er，以及多音节词前加 more。高中用法则强调比较级在复杂句中的灵活运用，包括数量比较、倍数比较、程度修饰（much, far, a lot, a little, even, still）以及“the + 比较级，the + 比较级”句型。

易错点一：than 后面的人称代词在正式书面语中用主格，在口语中可用宾格，但高考书面表达建议用主格加助动词，如 than I do。易错点二：less 和 fewer 的混用，不可数名词用 less，可数名词复数用 fewer。易错点三：比较级前不可再加 more，如不能说 more taller。易错点四：比较对象要一致，不能拿“人的体重”和“人”直接比较，需用 that of 或 those of 来替代。
forms: 单音节形容词比较级：adj. + -er（tall → taller；heavy → heavier；big → bigger）
多音节形容词比较级：more + adj.（more beautiful, more important）
数量比较结构：数量词 + more/less/fewer + 名词 + than + 比较对象
同级比较：as + 原级 + as；否定：not as/so + 原级 + as
程度修饰比较级：much / far / a lot / a little / even / still + 比较级
倍数比较：倍数 + as + 原级 + as / 倍数 + 比较级 + than
notes: 高考书面表达中，than 后代词建议用主格并补出助动词，如 than I do，避免语域偏低。
less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰可数名词复数，高考语法填空常在此设空。
比较级前不可再加 more，如 more taller 是错误结构，应直接用 taller 或 much taller。
比较对象要对称：拿 A 的某物与 B 的某物比较时，需用 that of / those of 替代，避免歧义。
“more than + 数量词”表示“超过、不止”，与“数量词 + more + 名词 + than”的比较结构不同，阅读中需根据语境区分。

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
examples.cn: 我哥哥比我高。

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.cn: 这本书比那本更有趣。

examples.en: She ate less rice than her sister did.
examples.cn: 她吃的米饭比她姐姐少。

examples.en: Heavy people sit on average two and a half hours more each day than people who are fit.
examples.cn: 体重较重的人平均每天比健康的人多坐两个半小时。

examples.en: The new policy has resulted in far fewer accidents than expected.
examples.cn: 新政策带来的事故比预期的少得多。

examples.en: The more you practice, the more confident you become.
examples.cn: 你练习得越多，就变得越自信。

exercises.q: My brother is ______ than me.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 tall 的比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: This bag is ______ (small) than that one.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 small 的比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is more taller than his brother." is correct.
exercises.explain: tall 是单音节形容词，比较级应直接加 -er，不能用 more。

exercises.q: This book is interesting. That book is more interesting. (合并为一句，用 than)
exercises.answer: That book is more interesting than this book.
exercises.explain: 用 more interesting than 连接两个比较对象。

exercises.q: This apple is more red than that one.
exercises.answer: This apple is redder than that one.
exercises.explain: red 是单音节形容词，比较级应双写 d 再加 -er。

exercises.q: This box is ______ than that one.
exercises.explain: heavy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: Lucy has ______ books than Lily.
exercises.explain: many 的比较级是不规则形式 more，后接可数名词复数。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ than Jack.
exercises.explain: fast 是单音节形容词，比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: I am ______ at English this year than last year.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better。

exercises.q: My sister is two years ______ (old) than me.
exercises.explain: old 的比较级是 older，表示年龄更大。

exercises.q: The weather today is ______ (bad) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则形式 worse。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has fewer pencils than me." is correct.
exercises.explain: fewer 是 few 的比较级，用于可数名词，表示更少。

exercises.q: My bag is heavy. Your bag is heavier. (合并为一句，用 than)
exercises.answer: Your bag is heavier than my bag.
exercises.explain: 用 heavier than 连接两个比较对象。

exercises.q: Tom is 12 years old. Jack is 10 years old. (用 older 改写)
exercises.explain: 年龄更大用 older than 表达。

exercises.q: He is the taller in his class.
exercises.answer: He is the tallest in his class.
exercises.explain: 三者以上比较用最高级 the tallest。

exercises.q: The population of China is ______ than that of Japan.
exercises.explain: large 以 e 结尾，比较级直接加 -r。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______ and ______ (warm).
exercises.explain: 比较级连用表示"越来越……"。

exercises.q: The sentence "This city is much more cleaner than before." is correct.
exercises.explain: clean 是单音节形容词，比较级用 cleaner，不能用 more cleaner。

exercises.q: This room is 20 square meters. That room is 25 square meters. (用 bigger 改写)
exercises.answer: That room is bigger than this room.
exercises.explain: 面积更大用 bigger than 表达。

exercises.q: This is the more beautiful city I have ever visited.
exercises.answer: This is the most beautiful city I have ever visited.
exercises.explain: ever visited 表示范围，应用最高级 the most beautiful。

exercises.q: This question is ______ than the last one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 difficult 的比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: She spends ______ time on homework than her classmates.
exercises.explain: time 是不可数名词，little 的比较级 less 修饰不可数名词。

exercises.q: The film is ______ than I expected.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 interesting 的比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: He is ______ than any other student in his class.
exercises.explain: clever 的比较级是 cleverer，than any other 表示最高级含义。

exercises.q: He is ______ (careful) than his brother.
exercises.explain: careful 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more 构成。

exercises.q: There are ______ (few) students in Class 2 than in Class 1.
exercises.explain: few 的比较级 fewer 修饰可数名词复数。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has less friends than I do." is correct.
exercises.explain: friends 是可数名词复数，应用 fewer 而不是 less。

exercises.q: Tom has 5 books. Jack has 3 books. (用 fewer 改写)
exercises.answer: Jack has fewer books than Tom.
exercises.explain: 可数名词数量更少用 fewer than。

exercises.q: The red car is expensive. The blue car is more expensive. (合并为一句)
exercises.answer: The blue car is more expensive than the red car.
exercises.explain: 用 more expensive than 连接两个比较对象。

exercises.q: My brother is two years more old than me.
exercises.answer: My brother is two years older than me.
exercises.explain: old 是单音节形容词，比较级用 older，不能用 more old。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ you will become.
exercises.explain: the more...the better 是固定句型，表示"越……越……"。

exercises.q: The ______ (hard) you work, the ______ (good) grades you will get.
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 表示"越……越……"。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is the most cleverest student in her class." is correct.
exercises.explain: cleverest 已经是最高级，不能再加 most。

exercises.q: This city is beautiful. That city is more beautiful. (用 less 改写，保持原意)
exercises.answer: This city is less beautiful than that city.
exercises.explain: 用 less beautiful than 表达反向比较，保持原意。

exercises.q: The weather in Beijing is colder than Shanghai.
exercises.answer: The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai.
exercises.explain: 比较对象应一致，用 that 指代 the weather。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ more difficult than that one.
exercises.explain: much 可以修饰比较级，表示"……得多"。

exercises.q: He is ______ of the two brothers.
exercises.explain: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。

exercises.q: The number of students in our school is ______ than that in theirs.
exercises.explain: number 表示数量，用 large 的比较级 larger 修饰。

exercises.q: I have never seen a ______ film than this one.
exercises.explain: 否定词 + 比较级表示最高级含义，意为"没有比这更好的了"。

exercises.q: This book is ______ (far) more interesting than that one.
exercises.explain: far 可以修饰比较级，表示"……得多"。

exercises.q: He is ______ (little) interested in music than his sister.
exercises.explain: little 的比较级 less 修饰形容词 interested，表示"更不感兴趣"。

exercises.q: The sentence "He is no taller than his brother." means he is as short as his brother.
exercises.explain: no taller than 表示"和……一样不高"，即两者都矮。

exercises.q: Tom is 1.7 meters tall. Jack is 1.7 meters tall. (用 as...as 改写)
exercises.answer: Tom is as tall as Jack.
exercises.explain: 两者相同用 as + 形容词原级 + as 表达。

exercises.q: He has more money than I do. (用 less 改写，保持原意)
exercises.answer: I have less money than he does.
exercises.explain: 用 less 从另一个角度表达相同的比较关系。

exercises.q: He is more friendlier than his brother.
exercises.answer: He is friendlier than his brother.
exercises.explain: friendly 的比较级是 friendlier，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: My brother is ______ than me. He always gets up earlier.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 lazy 变比较级时需将 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: The weather today is much ______ (cold) than yesterday.
exercises.explain: cold 是单音节形容词，比较级直接加 -er。

exercises.q: The sentence "She is more taller than her sister" is correct.
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应去掉 more。

exercises.q: This room is larger than that room. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: This room is not larger than that room.
exercises.explain: 含 be 动词的句子变否定句时在 be 后加 not。

exercises.q: This question is more easier than that one.
exercises.answer: This question is easier than that one.
exercises.explain: easier 已经是比较级，不能与 more 连用，应去掉 more。

exercises.q: This book is ______ than that one. I can finish it in one day.
exercises.explain: thin 是重读闭音节结尾，比较级需双写末尾辅音字母再加 -er。

exercises.q: She eats ______ vegetables than her sister.
exercises.explain: vegetables 是可数名词复数，表示"更少"要用 fewer。

exercises.q: Tom runs ______ than any other student in his class.
exercises.explain: fast 是单音节形容词，比较级直接加 -er，不能用 more。

exercises.q: There is ______ milk in this glass than in that one.
exercises.explain: milk 是不可数名词，表示"更少"要用 less。

exercises.q: My bag is ______ (heavy) than yours because I have more books.
exercises.explain: heavy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变比较级时 y 改为 i 再加 -er。

exercises.q: He has ______ (many) friends than I do.
exercises.explain: many 的比较级是不规则变化 more。

exercises.q: In the sentence "This box is bigger than that one", "bigger" is the comparative form of "big".
exercises.explain: big 是重读闭音节结尾，比较级双写 g 再加 -er，即 bigger。

exercises.q: My sister is taller than me. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is your sister taller than you?
exercises.explain: 含 be 动词的句子变一般疑问句时将 be 动词提到句首，人称做相应调整。

exercises.q: He is stronger than his friend. (用 not as...as 改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: His friend is not as strong as him.
exercises.explain: not as...as 结构表示"不如……"，用于表达比较关系。

exercises.q: She has less books than her brother.
exercises.answer: She has fewer books than her brother.
exercises.explain: books 是可数名词复数，表示"更少"应用 fewer 而非 less。

exercises.q: The new bridge is ______ than the old one, so it can carry more traffic.
exercises.explain: wide 的比较级是 wider，much 可修饰比较级表示"……得多"。

exercises.q: The more you practice, the ______ (good) you will become.
exercises.explain: "the + 比较级, the + 比较级"结构表示"越……越……"，good 的比较级是 better。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more you read, the more you know" uses the comparative structure correctly.
exercises.explain: "the + 比较级, the + 比较级"结构表示"越……越……"，此处使用正确。

exercises.q: This task is not as difficult as that one. (用比较级改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: That task is more difficult than this one.
exercises.explain: not as...as 表示"不如"，改写为比较级时需调整比较对象顺序。

exercises.q: The population of China is larger than America.
exercises.answer: The population of China is larger than that of America.
exercises.explain: 比较对象应对等，population 与 population 比较，需用 that 指代前面的 population。

exercises.q: Compared with last year, we spent ______ money on books this year.
exercises.explain: money 是不可数名词，表示"更少的钱"要用 less。

exercises.q: The situation is getting ______. We need to do something about it.
exercises.explain: "比较级+and+比较级"表示"越来越……"，bad 的比较级是不规则的 worse。

exercises.q: He is ______ of the two brothers.
exercises.explain: 两者中"较……的那个"用"the + 比较级"结构。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ than the one we solved yesterday.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 difficult 的比较级是 more difficult，far 可修饰比较级加强语气。

exercises.q: This film is ______ (interesting) than the one we saw last week.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 interesting 的比较级需用 more 构成。

exercises.q: She is two years ______ (old) than her cousin.
exercises.explain: old 的比较级是 older，前面可加具体数量表示差距。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She is the most intelligent of all the students", "most intelligent" is a comparative form.
exercises.explain: most intelligent 是最高级形式，不是比较级。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is as tall as Jack. (用比较级改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: Jack is taller than any other student in the class.
exercises.explain: 用比较级表达最高级含义时，常用"比较级 + than any other + 单数名词"结构。

exercises.q: He has more free time than I do. (用 less 改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: I have less free time than he does.
exercises.explain: 将比较对象互换后，more 需改为 less 以保持句意一致。

exercises.q: This is the more interesting book I have ever read.
exercises.answer: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
exercises.explain: ever 表示"曾经"，与最高级连用，此处应用 most interesting 而非 more interesting。

exercises.q: The more he tried to explain, ______ confused she became.
exercises.explain: "the + 比较级, the + 比较级"结构表示"越……越……"，confused 的比较级是 more confused。

exercises.q: The ______ (careful) you are, the fewer mistakes you will make.
exercises.explain: "the + 比较级, the + 比较级"结构中，careful 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more careful。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She is no less talented than her sister", the speaker implies that both sisters are equally talented.
exercises.explain: "no less...than" 表示"不少于，不亚于"，暗示两者才华相当。

exercises.q: She is more diligent than any other student in her class. (用最高级改写，保持句意基本不变)
exercises.answer: She is the most diligent student in her class.
exercises.explain: "比较级 + than any other + 单数名词"可转换为最高级表达。

exercises.q: The more you worry about the outcome, the less likely you will succeed.

grammar.key: Present Simple Tense for Habits / 一般现在时 (表示习惯)
grammar.title: 一般现在时表示习惯、常规与普遍真理（含 when 条件句 + 祈使句，拓展 can/could/may/might 等情态动词）
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Tense for Habits, Routines and General Truths (with When-Clauses, Imperatives, and Modal Extensions)
grammar.usage:
一般现在时（Present Simple Tense）在高中阶段不仅是“表示经常发生的动作”，更常用于描述习惯、日常规律、普遍真理以及时间/条件状语从句中的将来含义。其核心结构为：主语 + 动词原形（第三人称单数加 -s/-es）。否定形式在动词前加 do not / does not，疑问形式将 do / does 提前。例如：He usually drinks clear soup before the main course.（他通常在主菜前喝清汤。）否定：He does not usually drink clear soup. 疑问：Does he usually drink clear soup before the main course?

在“When + 一般现在时，+ 祈使句”这一句型中，when 从句描述一个反复发生的情境，主句用祈使句给出习惯性建议或指令。例如：When you have a meal, order a clear soup. 这里的 have 不是表示“正在吃”，而是表示“每当用餐时”这一习惯性条件。高中阶段需要特别注意：when 引导的时间状语从句中，即使语义指向将来，也必须用一般现在时，而不能用 will。例如：When you arrive, call me.（√）When you will arrive, call me.（×）

与近义结构对比：一般现在时与现在进行时（Present Continuous）的区别是高考高频考点。一般现在时强调习惯性、重复性、客观事实；现在进行时强调此刻正在发生或临时性的动作。例如：I usually have soup before dinner.（习惯）I am having soup now.（此刻正在喝）。此外，一般现在时还可与频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never）连用，而进行时通常不与这些表示常态频率的副词搭配表示习惯。

初中用法主要停留在“主语三单加-s”和“经常做某事”的层面；高中用法则进一步拓展到：1）在时间、条件状语从句中代替将来时；2）用于科学事实、客观真理、新闻标题、操作说明等语域；3）与情态动词 can / could / may / might / be able to 连用，表达习惯性可能性、能力或建议。例如：When you feel tired, you may take a short break.（当你感到累时，可以稍作休息。）这里的 may 表示允许或建议，而 when 从句仍用一般现在时。

易错点：1）第三人称单数漏加 -s，尤其在长句中主语与动词被修饰语隔开时；2）在 when / if / as soon as / unless 等引导的状语从句中误用 will；3）将客观真理或习惯性动作误用为进行时；4）否定和疑问句中忘记还原动词原形，例如 He doesn't drinks 是错误形式，应为 He doesn't drink。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + 动词原形 / 动词第三人称单数形式（-s/-es）
否定句：主语 + do/does + not + 动词原形
疑问句：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
When/If/As soon as + 主语 + 一般现在时，+ 祈使句/情态动词 + 动词原形
主语 + 频率副词（always/usually/often/sometimes/rarely/never）+ 动词原形/三单
主语 + can/could/may/might/be able to + 动词原形（表示习惯性可能、能力或建议）
notes: 高考书面表达中，when 引导的时间状语从句表将来时，从句必须用一般现在时，主句可用祈使句或将来时，不可在从句中用 will。
第三人称单数动词加 -s/-es 是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点，尤其注意以 -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o 结尾的动词加 -es。
一般现在时与现在进行时的语域差异：客观事实、科学真理、操作说明、新闻标题用一般现在时；描述照片、现场直播或临时状态用进行时。
在否定句和疑问句中，助动词 do/does 已经体现时态和人称，主动词必须还原为原形，这是高中写作中常见的隐性错误。
情态动词 can/could/may/might 与一般现在时连用时，表达习惯性可能性或建议，语气比单纯祈使句更委婉，适用于高中书面语中的建议类写作。

grammar.key: Adjective Clauses with 'who' / 由'who'引导的定语从句
grammar.title: 由 who 引导的定语从句（拓展：who / whom / whose / that 及省略）
grammar.titleEn: Adjective Clauses with 'who' (Extended: who / whom / whose / that / omission)
grammar.usage:
定语从句（又称关系从句）用于修饰名词或代词，提供更具体的信息。当先行词指人时，常用关系代词 who 引导定语从句，who 在从句中充当主语。例如：people who eat at least three apples a day 中，who eat at least three apples a day 修饰 people，说明是“每天至少吃三个苹果的人”。

核心结构为：先行词（指人）+ who + 谓语动词 + 其他成分。肯定句中 who 从句直接跟在先行词之后；否定句在从句谓语部分加 not 或使用否定助动词；疑问句中 who 引导的定语从句可嵌入特殊疑问句或一般疑问句，如：Do you know the man who is standing there? 此时 who 从句不改变主句的疑问语序。

who 与 that 在指人时通常可以互换，但 who 更正式，且在非限制性定语从句中只能用 who，不能用 that。whom 是 who 的宾格形式，在从句中作宾语，书面语中常用，口语中常省略或用 who/that 替代。whose 表示所属关系，意为“某人的”。当 who/whom/that 在定语从句中作宾语时，可以省略，但作主语时不能省略。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 who 作主语的基本用法，以及 who/which/that 的基本选择。高中阶段则需进一步掌握：who 与 whom 的语域差异、whose 表所属、介词 + whom 的正式结构、非限制性定语从句中 who 的使用、以及定语从句中主谓一致等更复杂的语法现象。

易错点一：从句谓语动词的单复数要与先行词保持一致，而不是与 who 本身一致。例如：The man who lives next door is a doctor.（先行词 man 是单数，从句动词用 lives）。易错点二：who 作主语时不能省略，作宾语时可以省略。例如：The person (who/whom) I met yesterday is kind. 中 who/whom 可省略，但 The person who helped me is kind. 中 who 不可省略。易错点三：非限制性定语从句中，先行词与从句之间用逗号隔开，且只能用 who/whom/whose，不能用 that。易错点四：介词后接关系代词时，指人只能用 whom，不能用 who 或 that。例如：The teacher with whom I talked is patient.
forms: 先行词（人）+ who + 谓语动词 + 其他（who 作主语）
先行词（人）+ whom/who/that + 主语 + 谓语（whom/who/that 作宾语，可省略）
先行词（人）+ whose + 名词 + 谓语（whose 表所属）
介词 + whom + 主语 + 谓语（正式书面语）
先行词（人），+ who/whom/whose + 从句（非限制性定语从句）
those who + 谓语动词（those who 指“那些……的人”）
notes: 高考书面语中，介词后接关系代词指人时只能用 whom，不能用 who 或 that，如：the colleague with whom I worked。
who 在定语从句中作主语时不可省略；作宾语时在口语和非正式语体中常省略，但高考语法填空常考“作主语不能省”这一规则。
非限制性定语从句中，who 不能换成 that，且从句前后需用逗号与主句隔开，这是高考短文改错和语法填空的高频考点。
whose 不仅可指人，也可指物，表示所属关系，高考中常与 of which 进行同义转换考查。
those who 结构中，who 从句的谓语动词用复数形式，因为 those 表示复数概念，这是高考主谓一致的重要考点。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从“过去”连接到“现在”的核心时态（含 have been to / have gone to / 与一般过去时对比）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: Connecting Past to Present
grammar.usage:
现在完成时的核心结构是“have/has + 过去分词”。它不单纯描述过去，而是站在“现在”的角度回望过去，表达两种主要含义：一是动作或状态从过去开始一直持续到现在，常与 for、since 搭配；二是动作发生在过去某个不确定的时间，但对现在有影响或结果，常与 already、yet、just、ever、never、recently、lately 等连用。

肯定句用“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。第三人称单数用 has，其余人称用 have。例如：She has lived here since 2019. / I haven't seen that film yet. / Have you ever tried Japanese food?

与一般过去时对比：一般过去时只强调动作发生在过去，常与明确的过去时间连用（yesterday、last week、in 2010、two days ago）；现在完成时则强调过去与现在的联系，不与明确的过去时间连用。例如：I saw the movie yesterday.（只说明昨天看了）vs I have seen the movie.（强调现在知道内容或已有经历）。

初中阶段主要掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本构成，以及 already、yet、ever、never、just、for、since 等标志词的用法。高中阶段需要进一步区分 have been to（去过某地，已回来）、have gone to（去了某地，还没回来）、have been in（在某地待了多久），并能在书面表达中准确使用现在完成时与 since 引导的时间状语从句、现在完成进行时的区别，以及“It is/has been + 一段时间 + since...”等高级句型。

易错点：1）过去分词形式容易写错，尤其是不规则动词，如 go—went—gone、eat—ate—eaten、see—saw—seen；2）把现在完成时与明确的过去时间连用，如“I have seen him yesterday”是错误的；3）have been to 与 have gone to 混淆；4）since 后面接时间点，for 后面接时间段，两者不可混用。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 其他）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ 其他）
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
have been to + 地点：去过某地（已回来）
have gone to + 地点：去了某地（未回来）
have been in + 地点 + for/since + 时间：在某地待了多久
notes: 高考书面表达中，since 引导时间状语从句时，主句常用现在完成时，从句用一般过去时，如：Great changes have taken place since the new policy was carried out.
注意 have been to 与 have gone to 的语域差异：have been to 强调经历，have gone to 强调“人不在此处”，后者不能用于第一人称。
在正式书面语中，现在完成时可与 recently、lately、so far、up to now、over the past few years 等搭配，体现时间跨度与当前相关性。
不要将现在完成时与明确的过去时间状语连用，这是高考语法填空和短文改错中的高频错误。
注意“It is/has been + 一段时间 + since + 一般过去时”句型中，主句用 is 或 has been 均可，但 since 从句必须用一般过去时。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can play now.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础用法到高中拓展（含不定式对比与形式主语）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Core Usage and Extended Patterns
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语，是把动词的 -ing 形式当作名词来使用，让一个动作或行为成为句子的主语。其核心结构为“动名词/动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词”，谓语动词通常用第三人称单数形式，如 is、makes、requires、has 等。动名词作主语时，整个动名词短语被视为一个整体概念，因此即使短语中包含复数名词，谓语动词仍然用单数。

肯定句直接以动名词开头，例如：Reading widely helps you write better. 否定形式是在动名词前加 not，例如：Not getting enough sleep affects your memory. 疑问形式通常借助形式主语 it 来构成，例如：Is it worth spending so much time on this? 在书面语中，动名词作主语的疑问句较少直接以动名词开头，更多使用 it 作形式主语的结构。

动名词作主语与不定式作主语在意义上存在细微差别。动名词通常表示一种普遍的、习惯性的或已知的活动，强调行为本身和经验；不定式则往往带有“将要去做”的意味，强调具体、未发生的动作。例如：Swimming is relaxing 表示“游泳这项活动让人放松”，而 To swim in that cold lake is dangerous 则更强调“去那个冷水湖游泳”这一具体行为。高中阶段需要掌握在特定句型中两者不可随意互换的情况，例如 It is no use doing、There is no point in doing 等固定结构中只能用动名词。

初中阶段主要要求识别动名词作主语的基本形式，并掌握谓语动词用单数这一规则。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，能够区分动名词作主语与现在进行时，前者 -ing 形式在主语位置，后者 -ing 形式与 be 动词共同构成谓语；第二，掌握动名词短语作主语时的主谓一致问题，尤其是短语较长、中心词不明显时；第三，熟悉形式主语 it 替代动名词的句型，如 It is worth doing、It is no use doing；第四，在书面表达中恰当使用动名词作主语来提升句式的多样性，避免一味使用人称代词开头。

易错点一：动名词作主语时，谓语动词的单复数判断。无论动名词短语中是否含有复数名词，谓语动词一律用单数，例如：Reading books is my hobby，不能说 Reading books are my hobby。易错点二：动名词与不定式作主语的意义差异，在高考书面表达中混用可能导致语义偏差。易错点三：动名词作主语与现在分词作定语或状语混淆，例如：Running water is clean 中 running 是现在分词作定语，而 Running is healthy 中 Running 是动名词作主语。易错点四：在 It is no use doing 等固定句型中误用不定式，例如：It is no use to cry 是错误的，应说 It is no use crying。
forms: 动名词 + 单数谓语动词：Reading books is a good habit.
动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词：Eating too much fast food causes health problems.
否定形式：Not + 动名词 + 单数谓语动词：Not exercising regularly leads to weight gain.
形式主语 it 结构：It is + 形容词/名词 + 动名词：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
固定句型：There is no point (in) + 动名词：There is no point in arguing with him.
动名词作主语与不定式对比：Swimming is fun. / To swim in winter is challenging.
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数形式，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词，如：Reading books is important，不能说 Reading books are important。
高考书面表达中，动名词作主语比不定式作主语更常用于表达普遍性、习惯性的行为，而表示具体、未发生的动作时优先考虑不定式。
不要将动名词作主语与现在进行时混淆。现在进行时的结构是“主语 + be + V-ing”，其中 V-ing 是谓语的一部分；而动名词作主语时，V-ing 本身位于主语位置，后面另有谓语动词。
在 It is no use / no good / worth 等固定句型中，只能用动名词，不能用不定式，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的常见考点。
语域方面，动名词作主语在正式书面语中比口语中更常见，尤其在议论文和说明文中，用动名词开头可以增强句式的客观性和正式感。

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Advice / 表示建议的情态动词
grammar.title: 表示建议的情态动词：should / ought to / had better / may / might 及间接建议结构
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Advice: should, ought to, had better, may, might and Indirect Recommendation Structures
grammar.usage:
表示建议的情态动词在英语中用来提出劝告、推荐或表达某种行为是明智的。最核心的结构是“情态动词 + 动词原形”，其中 should 最为常用，表示“应该做某事”；ought to 语气比 should 稍强，带有道义或责任上的“理应”；had better 则表示“最好做某事”，含有如果不做可能产生不良后果的意味。肯定式直接给出建议，否定式在情态动词后加 not，疑问式把情态动词提到主语前。

在近义结构对比上，should 语气中性、适用范围最广；ought to 更正式，常见于书面语和英式英语；had better 带有警告色彩，常用于口语和熟人之间；may / might 在表示建议时语气更委婉，常与 as well 连用，如 You might as well start now，表示“不妨”。此外，英语中还存在大量间接建议结构，例如用比较级或最高级表达推荐，如 A balanced diet is the best choice，或用 It is advisable / recommended to do 等句型。

初中阶段主要掌握 should 和 had better 的基本用法，能区分肯定、否定和疑问形式；高中阶段则需要进一步掌握 ought to 的正式语域、may / might 的委婉建议功能，以及通过比较级、逻辑连接词 hence / therefore 等引出的间接建议。高考书面表达中，恰当使用 ought to 和间接建议结构能提升文章的正式感和逻辑性。

易错点包括：had better 后接动词原形，不能加 to；ought to 的否定形式是 ought not to，疑问形式把 ought 提前；should 与 ought to 在多数情况下可互换，但 ought to 更强调客观义务；may / might 表建议时不能用于疑问句表示“我该不该”，而要用 should。
forms: 主语 + should / ought to / had better + 动词原形
主语 + should not / ought not to / had better not + 动词原形
Should / Ought + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
主语 + may / might + as well + 动词原形（表示“不妨”）
It is advisable / recommended / better + to do sth（间接建议）
比较级 / 最高级 + 名词 + is a better / the best choice（间接推荐）
notes: had better 后必须接动词原形，不能加 to；否定形式是 had better not，不要写成 had not better。
ought to 在否定和疑问中容易出错：否定是 ought not to，疑问是 Ought I to...?，to 不能省略。
高考书面语中，ought to 比 should 更正式，适合议论文和正式信函；口语中过度使用会显得生硬。
may / might 表建议时语气委婉，常见于 may/might as well 结构，但不能用于疑问句来询问“我该不该做某事”。
间接建议结构常与 hence、therefore、thus 等逻辑连接词连用，高考阅读理解中需识别这类隐含建议。

grammar.key: Relative Clause (Non-defining) / 非限制性定语从句
grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句：which / who / whom / whose 的拓展用法
grammar.titleEn: Non-defining Relative Clauses: which, who, whom, whose and beyond
grammar.usage:
非限制性定语从句用于对先行词进行补充说明，而不是限定或区分先行词的身份。其核心结构是：主句 + 逗号 + 关系词引导的从句 + 逗号 + 主句剩余部分（或从句位于句末时只在前加逗号）。关系词的选择取决于先行词是人还是物：先行词指人时用 who（作主语）或 whom（作宾语），指物时用 which，表示所属关系时用 whose。与限制性定语从句不同，非限制性定语从句中的关系词在任何情况下都不能省略，也不能用 that 替换。

肯定句结构为“先行词 + 逗号 + 关系词 + 从句谓语 + 其他”，否定句在从句中加入 not 或 never 等否定词，疑问句则是对主句部分进行提问，从句保持陈述语序。例如：The new library, which was opened last year, is very popular among students. 否定形式：The new library, which was not opened until last year, is already very popular. 疑问形式：Is the new library, which was opened last year, very popular among students?

初中阶段通常只要求掌握限制性定语从句，以及少量由 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，重点在于识别逗号和理解补充信息。高中阶段则要求系统掌握 who、whom、whose、which 在非限制性定语从句中的分工，理解“介词 + which/whom”结构，并能判断关系词在从句中所充当的句子成分。此外，高中还涉及 which 指代整个主句内容的用法，以及非限制性定语从句在书面表达中的修辞功能。

与限制性定语从句的核心区别在于：限制性定语从句去掉后，先行词的身份或范围会变得不明确；而非限制性定语从句去掉后，主句的核心意思仍然完整。例如：The students who passed the exam were happy.（限制性：只有通过考试的学生高兴）对比：The students, who passed the exam, were happy.（非限制性：所有学生都通过了考试，且他们都高兴）。与同位语从句的区别在于：非限制性定语从句的 which/who 在从句中充当成分，而同位语从句的 that 不充当成分。与并列句的区别在于：非限制性定语从句必须依附于先行词，而并列句用 and/but 等连接两个独立分句。

易错点一：在非限制性定语从句中使用 that。这是高考书面表达中的高频扣分点，必须用 which/who/whom/whose。易错点二：逗号位置错误。非限制性定语从句若位于句中，前后都要有逗号；若位于句末，前面必须有逗号。易错点三：关系词省略。非限制性定语从句中关系词绝对不能省略，即使它在从句中作宾语。易错点四：which 指代不清。当 which 指代整个主句时，要确保先行内容明确，避免歧义。
forms: 先行词（人）+ , who + 谓语 + 其他
先行词（人）+ , whom + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他
先行词（物）+ , which + 谓语/主语 + 谓语 + 其他
先行词（人或物）+ , whose + 名词 + 谓语 + 其他
先行词 + , 介词 + which/whom + 从句其他部分
主句 + , which + 谓语 + 其他（which 指代整个主句）
notes: 高考书面表达中，非限制性定语从句中绝对不能使用 that，只能用 which/who/whom/whose，这是阅卷中重点检查的语法点。
关系词在非限制性定语从句中不可省略，即使作宾语也不能省略，这与限制性定语从句的省略规则不同。
当 which 指代整个主句内容时，从句谓语用单数形式，且 which 前必须有逗号，这种用法在高考阅读和写作中都很常见。
注意区分 who 和 whom：who 在从句中作主语，whom 作宾语。在介词后只能用 whom，不能用 who。
非限制性定语从句常用于书面语和正式文体，口语中较少使用，因此在高考作文中适当使用可以提升语域和表达层次。

examples.en: My uncle, who is a pilot, travels to many countries every year.
examples.cn: 我的叔叔是一名飞行员，他每年都会去很多国家。

examples.en: The Eiffel Tower, which is in Paris, is visited by millions of tourists.
examples.cn: 埃菲尔铁塔位于巴黎，每年有数百万游客参观。

examples.en: Our English teacher, whose lessons are always interesting, has taught here for ten years.
examples.cn: 我们的英语老师已经在这里教了十年，他的课总是很有趣。

examples.en: The company hired three new managers, two of whom had worked abroad before.
examples.cn: 公司雇用了三位新经理，其中两位之前在国外工作过。

examples.en: The research project, on which the team spent two years, was finally completed last month.
examples.cn: 这个研究项目，团队花了两年时间，终于在上个月完成了。

examples.en: He failed the driving test again, which disappointed his parents greatly.
examples.cn: 他驾驶考试又没通过，这让他的父母非常失望。

grammar.key: Passive Voice (Past Participle as Adjective) / 被动语态（过去分词作形容词）
grammar.title: 被动语态与过去分词作形容词（含 be + done / 过去分词作定语和表语）
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice and Past Participles as Adjectives
grammar.usage:
本语法点包含两个密切相关但功能不同的结构：一是被动语态“be + 过去分词”，表示主语承受某个动作；二是过去分词作形容词，表示主语或名词所处的状态或性质。被动语态的核心结构为“主语 + be + 过去分词（+ by + 动作执行者）”，其中 be 需要根据时态、人称和数进行变化。肯定句如：The iron is digested in the body. 否定句在 be 后加 not：The iron is not digested easily. 一般疑问句将 be 提前：Is the iron digested easily? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接一般疑问句语序：How is the iron digested? 如果强调动作执行者，可在句末用 by 引出；如果不清楚或不重要，常省略 by 短语。

过去分词作形容词时，可以放在名词前作定语，如 a broken window（一扇破了的窗户）、the iron found in the yolk（蛋黄中发现的铁）；也可以放在系动词后作表语，如 The window is broken（窗户破了）、I am interested in science（我对科学感兴趣）。作定语时，过去分词往往含有被动或完成意义，相当于一个省略的定语从句，例如 the iron found in the yolk 可以理解为 the iron that is found in the yolk。作表语时，过去分词描述主语的状态或感受，而不是强调动作过程。

被动语态与过去分词作形容词的主要区别在于：被动语态强调“动作被实施”的过程，常可加 by 短语，也可与时间状语连用；过去分词作形容词强调“状态”或“性质”，一般不加 by 短语，也不强调动作发生的时间。例如：The door was closed by the teacher at 5 p.m.（被动语态，强调关门动作）与 The door was closed when I arrived.（形容词作表语，强调门处于关闭状态）。此外，部分过去分词已经高度形容词化，如 interested, excited, surprised, tired, bored 等，常与介词搭配，表示人的心理状态。

初中阶段主要要求掌握一般现在时和一般过去时的被动语态，以及少量常见的过去分词形容词（如 interested, excited, broken, closed）。高中阶段则需进一步掌握：各种时态下的被动语态（如现在完成时、过去完成时、将来时、情态动词被动等）；过去分词短语作后置定语；过去分词与现在分词作形容词的区别；以及被动语态在科技、新闻、学术等书面语体中的高频使用。高中英语阅读和写作中，过去分词短语作定语和被动语态常同时出现，需要根据语境判断其功能。

易错点一：混淆过去分词作表语与被动语态。判断方法是看句子是否强调动作过程、能否加 by 短语、是否有明确的时间状语。易错点二：过去分词作定语时位置错误。单个过去分词一般前置，过去分词短语一般后置。易错点三：将不及物动词用于被动语态。只有及物动词或相当于及物动词的短语动词才有被动语态。易错点四：误用现在分词代替过去分词作形容词。现在分词多表示“令人……的”，过去分词多表示“感到……的”，如 interesting 与 interested。
forms: 被动语态基本结构：主语 + be + 过去分词 (+ by + 动作执行者)
否定式：主语 + be + not + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Be + 主语 + 过去分词 (+ 其他)?
过去分词作前置定语：过去分词 + 名词（如 a broken window）
过去分词短语作后置定语：名词 + 过去分词短语（如 the iron found in the yolk）
过去分词作表语：主语 + 系动词 + 过去分词（如 I am interested in science）
notes: 高考书面表达中，适当使用被动语态可使叙述更客观，尤其适用于科技说明、新闻报道和学术写作，但不宜通篇使用，以免句式单一。
过去分词短语作后置定语时，相当于一个省略的定语从句，高考阅读中常见，需根据名词与分词之间的被动关系判断。
注意不及物动词不能用于被动语态，如 happen, appear, disappear, remain 等；但有些不及物动词加介词构成短语动词后可变为被动，如 look after, talk about。
区分过去分词作表语和被动语态：若句子描述状态且不能加 by 短语，多为形容词用法；若强调动作且可加 by 短语或时间状语，多为被动语态。
在书面语中，过去分词短语作定语比定语从句更简洁，但需避免悬垂分词，即分词逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致。

examples.en: The window was broken by the boy.
examples.cn: 窗户被那个男孩打破了。

examples.en: I am interested in science.
examples.cn: 我对科学感兴趣。

examples.en: The letter was written by my sister.
examples.cn: 这封信是我姐姐写的。

examples.en: The iron found in the yolk is easily digested in the body.
examples.cn: 蛋黄中发现的铁很容易在体内被消化。

examples.en: The problem discussed at the meeting has not been solved yet.
examples.cn: 会上讨论的那个问题尚未被解决。

examples.en: Having been invited to give a speech, she felt both excited and nervous.
examples.cn: 被邀请做演讲后，她感到既兴奋又紧张。

exercises.q: The window is ______. Please be careful.
exercises.explain: is 后接过去分词 broken 作表语，表示窗户的状态。

exercises.q: The letter was ______ (write) by Tom last night.
exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The cake was made by my mother. 这句话是被动语态。
exercises.explain: was made 是 be + 过去分词，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: They clean the room every day. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: The room is cleaned every day.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态：is/are + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The window was break by the boy.
exercises.answer: The window was broken by the boy.
exercises.explain: 被动语态中 break 要用过去分词 broken。

exercises.q: The book ______ by my sister yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 提示过去时，被动语态用 was + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I found a ______ cup on the floor.
exercises.explain: 过去分词 broken 作定语修饰 cup，表示已经破了的杯子。

exercises.q: These apples ______ in Shandong.
exercises.explain: 苹果被种植，用一般现在时被动语态 are grown。

exercises.q: The door is ______ now. You can come in.
exercises.explain: open 在此处作形容词表示开着的状态，不是被动语态。

exercises.q: English is ______ (speak) in many countries.
exercises.explain: speak 的过去分词 spoken 用于被动语态。

exercises.q: The classroom is ______ (clean) every day.
exercises.explain: clean 的过去分词 cleaned 构成一般现在时被动语态。

exercises.q: The boy is running fast. 这句话是被动语态。
exercises.explain: is running 是现在进行时，不是被动语态。

exercises.q: The homework was done by Lucy. 改为主动语态。
exercises.explain: 被动转主动，主语 Lucy 发出动作，用过去时 did。

exercises.q: The bike is repaired by my father. 改为否定句。
exercises.answer: The bike is not repaired by my father.
exercises.explain: 被动语态否定在 be 动词后加 not。

exercises.q: The trees is planted every spring.
exercises.answer: The trees are planted every spring.
exercises.explain: 主语 trees 是复数，be 动词应用 are。

exercises.q: The food ______ easily in the body.
exercises.explain: 食物被消化，用被动语态 is digested。

exercises.q: The iron ______ (find) in the yolk is good for health.
exercises.explain: 过去分词 found 作后置定语，相当于 which is found。

exercises.q: The book written by Lu Xun is very famous. 其中 written 是过去分词作定语。
exercises.explain: written by Lu Xun 作后置定语修饰 book，表示被动含义。

exercises.q: People speak English all over the world. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: English is spoken all over the world.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态，主语 English 后用 is spoken。

exercises.q: The homework should finished on time.
exercises.answer: The homework should be finished on time.
exercises.explain: should 后需接 be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The bridge ______ in 2008.
exercises.explain: in 2008 是过去时间，用一般过去时被动语态。

exercises.q: I saw a dog ______ by a car just now.
exercises.explain: see sth done 结构中用过去分词 hit 作宾补，hit 的过去分词与原形相同。

exercises.q: The work must ______ before Friday.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The room ______ by the students now.
exercises.explain: now 提示正在进行，用现在进行时被动语态 is being cleaned。

exercises.q: The problem can be ______ (solve) easily.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接 be + 过去分词 solved。

exercises.q: The boy was ______ (send) to the hospital at once.
exercises.explain: send 的过去分词是 sent，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The window is broken. 这句话一定是被动语态。
exercises.explain: is broken 在此处更可能是系表结构，描述窗户的状态而非强调动作。

exercises.q: The letter was sent to him yesterday. 改为一般疑问句。
exercises.answer: Was the letter sent to him yesterday?
exercises.explain: 被动语态一般疑问句将 be 动词提前。

exercises.q: We can finish the task in two days. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: The task can be finished in two days.
exercises.explain: 情态动词被动语态：can be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The story was happened in 1990.
exercises.explain: happen 是不及物动词，不能用于被动语态。

exercises.q: The new law ______ into effect next month.
exercises.explain: next month 提示将来时，被动语态用 will be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The building ______ (build) at the moment will be a library.
exercises.explain: 现在分词被动式 being built 作后置定语，表示正在被建造的。

exercises.q: The house being painted now belongs to my uncle. 其中 being painted 表示正在被粉刷。
exercises.explain: being painted 是现在分词被动式作定语，表示正在进行的被动动作。

exercises.q: They are going to build a new school here. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: A new school is going to be built here.
exercises.explain: be going to 的被动语态：be going to be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The problem is difficult to be solved.
exercises.answer: The problem is difficult to solve.
exercises.explain: difficult 后的不定式用主动形式表示被动含义。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the meeting ______.
exercises.explain: end 在此处为不及物动词，用过去完成时主动形式 had ended。

exercises.q: The children ______ in the garden when it started to rain.
exercises.explain: 过去进行时被动语态 were being watched 表示当时正在被照看。

exercises.q: The novel ______ into several languages so far.
exercises.explain: so far 提示现在完成时，被动语态用 has been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The patient ______ by the doctor when I entered the room.
exercises.explain: when 引导的时间状语从句提示过去某时刻正在进行的被动动作。

exercises.q: He is said ______ (be) a great scientist.
exercises.explain: be said to be 是固定结构，表示据说某人是什么样的人。

exercises.q: The problem ______ (discuss) at the meeting tomorrow is very important.
exercises.explain: 不定式被动式 to be discussed 作后置定语，表示将要被讨论的。

exercises.q: The book is worth reading. 这句话中 reading 是被动含义。
exercises.explain: be worth doing 结构中 doing 用主动形式表示被动含义。

exercises.q: The teacher made him clean the classroom. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: He was made to clean the classroom.
exercises.explain: make sb do 变被动时需还原不定式 to，即 be made to do。

exercises.q: People believe that he is honest. 改为被动语态。
exercises.answer: It is believed that he is honest.
exercises.explain: it 作形式主语的被动结构：It is believed that...。

exercises.q: The boy was seen enter the building.
exercises.answer: The boy was seen to enter the building.
exercises.explain: 感官动词 see 在被动语态中需还原不定式 to。

exercises.q: The window ______ by the strong wind last night.
exercises.explain: last night 提示过去时，窗户是被风吹破的，用被动语态 was broken。

exercises.q: The bridge ______ (build) five years ago.
exercises.explain: five years ago 提示过去时，桥是被建造的，用 was built。

exercises.q: The sentence "The cake was made by my mother." is in the passive voice.
exercises.explain: was made 是 be + 过去分词结构，表示“蛋糕被做”，是被动语态。

exercises.q: People speak English in many countries. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态：主语 English + is spoken，执行者 people 不重要可省略。

exercises.q: The homework was finish by Tom last night.
exercises.answer: The homework was finished by Tom last night.
exercises.explain: 被动语态结构是 be + 过去分词，finish 应改为 finished。

exercises.q: Look at the ______ leaves on the ground. Autumn is here.
exercises.explain: fallen 作形容词修饰 leaves，表示“已经落下的叶子”，强调状态。

exercises.q: The food ______ in the fridge stays fresh for a longer time.
exercises.explain: kept in the fridge 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 the food，表示“被保存在冰箱里的食物”。

exercises.q: This book ______ by a famous writer in 2010.
exercises.explain: in 2010 是过去时间，书是被写的，用一般过去时被动语态。

exercises.q: The boy felt ______ when he heard the bad news.
exercises.explain: felt 是系动词，后面接形容词 sad 作表语，描述主语的状态。

exercises.q: The ______ (break) glass is dangerous. Don't touch it.
exercises.explain: broken 作形容词修饰 glass，表示“破碎的玻璃”，强调状态。

exercises.q: The letter ______ (write) in English is from my pen pal.
exercises.explain: written in English 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 the letter，表示“用英语写的信”。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The door is closed.", "closed" is a past participle used as an adjective.
exercises.explain: closed 在系动词 is 后作表语，描述门“关着的”状态，是过去分词作形容词。

exercises.q: The students cleaned the classroom yesterday. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The classroom was cleaned by the students yesterday.
exercises.explain: 一般过去时被动语态：主语 the classroom + was cleaned，执行者用 by 引出。

exercises.q: The story was written by a young writer. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: A young writer wrote the story.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动：by 后的执行者 a young writer 变为主语，谓语用过去式 wrote。

exercises.q: The breaking window needs to be repaired.
exercises.answer: The broken window needs to be repaired.
exercises.explain: 修饰 window 表示“破碎的”状态，应用过去分词 broken，而非 breaking。

exercises.q: The problem ______ at the meeting tomorrow is of great importance.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来，用不定式被动 to be discussed 作后置定语，表示“将要被讨论的问题”。

exercises.q: The book ______ (publish) last month has become a bestseller.
exercises.explain: published last month 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 the book，表示“上个月出版的书”。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The window is broken", "broken" is part of the passive voice, not an adjective.
exercises.explain: 此句中 broken 在系动词 is 后描述状态，是过去分词作形容词，而非被动语态强调动作。

exercises.q: They are building a new library in our school. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: A new library is being built in our school.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时被动语态：主语 a new library + is being built。

exercises.q: The report writing by the students is very interesting.
exercises.answer: The report written by the students is very interesting.
exercises.explain: report 与 write 是被动关系，应用过去分词 written 作后置定语。

exercises.q: ______ from the top of the hill, the city looks very beautiful.
exercises.explain: the city 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen 作状语，表示“从山顶被看”。

exercises.q: The students ______ in the classroom are having an English lesson.
exercises.explain: seated 作形容词表示“就座的”，修饰 students，相当于 who are seated。

exercises.q: The new bridge ______ by the end of next year.
exercises.explain: by the end of next year 提示将来完成时，桥是被完成的，用 will have been completed。

exercises.q: He was disappointed ______ the result of the exam.
exercises.explain: be disappointed at 表示“对……感到失望”，是固定搭配。

exercises.q: The meeting ______ (hold) now is about the school sports day.
exercises.explain: now 提示正在进行的被动动作，用 being held 作后置定语，表示“正在被举行的会议”。

exercises.q: The house ______ (build) for the old man will be finished soon.
exercises.explain: being built 表示“正在被建造的”，作后置定语修饰 the house，强调进行中的被动。

exercises.q: The sentence "The homework needs to be finished by Friday." contains a passive infinitive.
exercises.explain: to be finished 是不定式的被动形式，表示“需要被完成”。

exercises.q: The teacher gave me a book. (改为被动语态，以 I 为主语)
exercises.answer: I was given a book by the teacher.
exercises.explain: 双宾语动词 give 的被动语态，间接宾语 I 作主语，用 was given。

exercises.q: The boy who was injured in the accident was taken to hospital. (用过去分词短语改写)
exercises.answer: The boy injured in the accident was taken to hospital.
exercises.explain: 定语从句 who was injured 可简化为过去分词短语 injured in the accident 作后置定语。

exercises.q: The problem is needed to be solved as soon as possible.
exercises.answer: The problem needs to be solved as soon as possible.
exercises.explain: need 作实义动词时后接不定式，主语 the problem 与 solve 是被动关系，用 needs to be solved。

exercises.q: ______ in 1905, the museum is one of the oldest buildings in the city.
exercises.explain: museum 与 build 是被动关系，过去分词 Built 作状语，表示“建于1905年”。

exercises.q: The experiment ______ (conduct) by the scientists last year proved to be a great success.
exercises.explain: conducted by the scientists last year 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 experiment，表示“被进行的实验”。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The window was broken by the boy", "broken" is an adjective describing the state of the window.
exercises.explain: 此句中 was broken 是被动语态，强调“被男孩打破”的动作，broken 是过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The committee is considering the proposal. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The proposal is being considered by the committee.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时被动语态：主语 the proposal + is being considered。

exercises.q: The results obtained from the survey is being analyzed by the research team.
exercises.answer: The results obtained from the survey are being analyzed by the research team.
exercises.explain: 主语 results 是复数，谓语应用 are being analyzed，保持主谓一致。

exercises.q: The manager, ______ by the reporters, refused to answer any questions.
exercises.explain: manager 与 surround 是被动关系，过去分词 surrounded 作定语，相当于 who was surrounded。

exercises.q: ______ with the size of the whole earth, the highest mountain does not seem high at all.
exercises.explain: mountain 与 compare 是被动关系，Compared with 是固定搭配，表示“与……相比”。

exercises.q: The project ______ by the time the new manager arrives.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用将来完成时被动语态。

exercises.q: ______ in a hurry, the article was full of mistakes.
exercises.explain: article 与 write 是被动关系，过去分词 Written 作原因状语，表示“因为写得匆忙”。

exercises.q: The proposal ______ (submit) to the committee is under discussion.
exercises.explain: submitted to the committee 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 proposal，表示“被提交的提案”。

exercises.q: The novel ______ (translate) into many languages has gained worldwide popularity.
exercises.explain: translated into many languages 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 novel，表示“被翻译成多种语言的小说”。

exercises.q: The phrase "the iron found in the yolk" can be rewritten as "the iron that is found in the yolk".
exercises.explain: 过去分词短语 found in the yolk 作后置定语，可扩展为定语从句 that is found in the yolk。

exercises.q: The book that was written by the famous author has been translated into 20 languages. (用过去分词短语改写)
exercises.answer: The book written by the famous author has been translated into 20 languages.
exercises.explain: 定语从句 that was written 可简化为过去分词短语 written by the famous author 作后置定语。

exercises.q: People believe that the company will launch a new product next month. (改为被动语态，以 It 开头)
exercises.answer: It is believed that the company will launch a new product next month.
exercises.explain: It is believed that... 是常见的被动句型，表示“人们相信……”。

exercises.q: Having been discussed for hours, the committee finally made a decision.
exercises.answer: Having discussed for hours, the committee finally made a decision.
exercises.explain: committee 与 discuss 是主动关系，应用现在分词 Having discussed，而非被动形式。
